**Newsroom brief: Oil Prices Rose and US Stocks Fell as Treasury Moved to Double Debt Buybacks**

Al Jazeera reports higher crude prices and lower US stocks alongside an emergency Treasury move to double long-dated debt buybacks.

**Context:** The Treasury announced an emergency move to double long-dated debt buybacks in an attempt to calm the market.

Source-bound brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/oil-prices-us-stocks-treasury-debt-buybacks
